category_title: Bored students who engage in off-task behaviors
minimal_context: The student and tutor are in the classroom reviewing the assigned homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your homework so we can review the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do our homework. Even though we do our homework, they do not check, they do not reward, so we don't have the desire to do it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just look at the first question on the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: And sometimes they make a student to check the homework, and those students are unfair anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to continue with the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm bored. Let's change the subject. Did anyone watch the game on TV last night?
